content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have a setup with several [product_name] modules connected via Ethernet. When I toggle an input on one module, it sets an output on another. The simulation works perfectly, but on actual devices, there is sometimes a delay of up to 10 seconds before the output changes. Could this be due to too many network inputs in my configuration? I have attached my test application. Has anyone experienced a similar issue, or perhaps had a comparable setup without problems? I've tried many solutions and am now looking for additional advice. I'm eager to resolve this. Thanks.

Hello, Try disabling the keep-alive function. This may help since it holds the communication channel open for several seconds. Without it, the system should be able to process the next request more quickly. Hope this helps.

Hello [user_name], Thank you for your suggestion. I've tried it, but unfortunately the problem persists. - Are there any other recommendations? - Do you know what kind of delay is normal when using Ethernet connections? - Does anyone have experience with setups involving more than two [product_name] modules and, if so, have you encountered similar delays? Additional details: - All five [product_name] modules are connected to the same network hub. - The delay is intermittent; sometimes everything works without any lag for several attempts, but then the delay reappears briefly and then disappears again. Thanks, [user_name]

Hello, I'm not sure this will solve your issue, but it is possible to check the cycle time of your [product_name] module. Refer to the device manual for guidance on determining cycle time and performance specifics. See the section in the manual for more information.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are encountering inconsistent and occasionally lengthy delays—up to 10 seconds—when transferring input states between [product_name] modules over Ethernet in actual hardware setups. While simulated environments operate smoothly, real-world devices intermittently experience lag, casting doubt on reliability in distributed systems. The issue appears unpredictable and may relate to communication limitations or internal processing cycles of the hardware.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate prompt and consistent response—preferably almost instantaneous—between input activation on one device and output triggering on another through the Ethernet network. Their expectation is that the physical system's reliability matches that of the simulated setup.
